intent_snapshot.goal: Derive unique <=32-char backend session names from folded label plus ownership token slice in herdr and herdr-core SupervisedSessionPort providers (#502) under docs/specs/session-agent-name-uniqueness.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-REQ-1; meet BR-REQ-3, BR-REQ-4, BR-DEC-1, BR-DEC-2, BR-OUT-1, BR-OUT-2, and BR-SCN-1 in docs/specs/session-agent-name-uniqueness.spec.md: two live createSession calls with identical label coexist across fake, herdr, and herdr-core; herdrAgentName(label, token) obeys ^[a-z][a-z0-9_-]{0,31}$ across non-alpha prefixes and 32-char truncation; herdr --resume on an exited host reuses found.ids.token; fake-herdr rejects duplicate live agent names with agent_name_taken; and session boundary and advisory contracts stay intact.

Source BR-REQ-5 in docs/specs/session-agent-name-uniqueness.spec.md: docs/reference/supervised-session-port.md updates both herdr and herdr-core createSession naming rows, .changeset/session-agent-name-uniqueness.md is present, and dist doc mirrors, Claude/Antigravity plugin checks, and bun run typecheck pass.
